$comment: Curated forfeit destinations for MAST solo-mode forfeit plans (CommitmentEscrowV2.setForfeitPlan). Updated from time to time. RULE: an entry with "address": null is NOT usable until someone verifies the address on the org's OFFICIAL donation page and fills it in via PR. Never send funds to an unverified address — on Base, a typo is a burn.

burn.note: Canonical dead address. USDC rejects 0x0, so this is the burn destination. Irrecoverable by anyone.

mast_project.note: MAST creator's tip address. To be published by the project owner.

charities.name: GiveDirectly
charities.note: Accepts crypto; verify current USDC-on-Base address on the official page before use.

charities.name: Against Malaria Foundation
charities.note: Accepts crypto via The Giving Block; verify address and network support before use.

charities.name: Internet Archive
charities.note: Publishes crypto addresses directly on its donation page; confirm Base/USDC support.

charities.name: Electronic Frontier Foundation
charities.note: Accepts crypto; verify address and network support before use.

anticharities.$comment: Anticharity = an org the committer would hate to fund; the strongest motivator (the stickK model). MAST does not endorse these orgs — that is the point. Entries are user-supplied: pick an org whose mission you oppose, verify it accepts USDC on Base, and add its official donation address here or directly in your forfeit plan.
anticharities.name: (user-supplied)
anticharities.note: By design, anticharities are personal. Your agent should ask what you're against, then help you verify the org's official crypto donation address.
